resources.string: Enable flagged user and channel alerts

The built-in list is enabled by default. Checks people in private chats, channels themselves, and visible user or channel senders in groups by exact username or permanent ID, including photos and stickers. Each person or channel is shown once per chat visit; returning to the chat allows another alert. The list updates every 2 hours or manually, then checks the current chat again. Failed updates retain the last list.
No list URL configured. User and channel matching is inactive.

HTTPS plain text URL. One user ID, username, or channel ID per line, for example:
7637374698
@didb431
@channel_name
-1001234567890
channel:1234567890

Usernames without @ also work. Channel IDs use the -100 prefix or channel:rawID to keep them separate from positive user IDs. The earlier username/ID format also works. An empty file clears the list. Clear the URL to disable this source.
⚠ This user is on the risk list

User: %1$s
Permanent ID: %2$s

Be cautious with transactions. Open the profile to block or report.
Filters new message notifications without hiding messages. Conversation rules override the global rule. Existing mute settings still apply.
One keyword per line. Any matching keyword triggers a notification. Case insensitive, up to 200 keywords.
